name: stellar-club
description: 诺曼部落：uni-app H5 与微信小程序 / Vue 3 运营后台 / 可替换 Mock API

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:mp-weixin
scripts.preview:demo: SITE_OUTPUT_DIR=dist-demo HTTP_API_UPSTREAM= PORT=4180 npm run preview
scripts.demo: npm run build:demo && npm run preview:demo
scripts.build:acceptance: VITE_API_MODE=acceptance VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api SITE_OUTPUT_DIR=dist-acceptance npm run build
scripts.preview:acceptance: SITE_OUTPUT_DIR=dist-acceptance HTTP_API_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:8091 PORT=4190 npm run preview
scripts.build:http: VITE_API_MODE=http VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api SITE_OUTPUT_DIR=dist-http npm run build
scripts.preview:http: SITE_OUTPUT_DIR=dist-http HTTP_API_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:8080 PORT=4180 npm run preview
